theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid n)) (g : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (C : ℝ), IsCompact K → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K, |g j x| ≤ C) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, |g j x - g j y| ≤ C * ‖x - y‖) → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ S : Finset ℕ, ∀ j, ∃ k ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ K, |g j x - g k x| ≤ δ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
